_comment: Live trigger eval-set for plan-flow. Positives = plan/HOW-only requests with concrete WHAT input; negatives = spec-only, implementation, test, or ambiguous design requests.

queries.query: plan-flow ile onayli export spec'ine gore implementation plan ve task breakdown hazirla, kod yazma.
Use plan-flow to turn acceptance criteria 'user can export CSV and errors are reported' into ordered implementation steps and verification tasks.
plan-flow skill'i ile WHAT dokumani 'kullanici raporu CSV indirir' icin TDD noktalari, riskler ve sira planini cikar.
Sadece bu feature icin acceptance criteria ve spec yaz.
Bu plani simdi uygula ve feature'i ekle.
